trials.claim: Lifetime access to FlyMSG.io on Single plan
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to FlyMSG.io
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Please note: This deal is not stackable
- Unlimited templates FlyPlates
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports their account was reverted to FREEMIUM after 3 months, which directly conflicts with lifetime access. The defense showing a Growth plan does not prove the Single lifetime deal was kept.

exhibits.quote: Yes, you will be automatically charged each year on the anniversary date of your subscription at the full retail price regardless of any discount provided to you at the time of purchase.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states annual auto-charge at full retail price, contradicting lifetime access with no recurring payment.

exhibits.quote: Why is my account reverted back to FREEMIUM after 3 months? I couldn't even get the shortcuts to work on Social Media no matter what I do.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime account was downgraded to freemium after 3 months, undermining lifetime access claim.

exhibits.quote: Your current plan AppSumo Lifetime Growth Active
exhibits.argument: Review confirms account shows as AppSumo Lifetime Growth Active, supporting lifetime access claim.

exhibits.quote: the Vengresso team has not only respected the conditions of the original LTD, but new features have been added and, from my experience in the LTD universe, that's something that cannot be taken for granted.
exhibits.argument: Review confirms vendor has respected original LTD conditions, supporting lifetime access.
